summary: EPFO wage ceiling raised to ₹25,000; more employees to get PF, pension benefits SCC Online Employers and compliance managers are advised to evaluate potential impact on statutory payroll filings and workforce policies.

title: EPFO rolls out centralized Aadhaar-based Face Authentication for digital life certificates
summary: EPFO expanded its digital facial authentication mechanism across all regional offices, allowing EPS-95 pensioners to submit their annual Jeevan Pramaan life certificates directly via smartphone camera, removing the need for physical visits or biometric fingerprint scanners.

title: CS Atal Dulloo reviews implementation of new Labour Codes and draft rules across Jammu & Kashmir
summary: Chief Secretary Atal Dulloo chaired a high-level review of Jammu & Kashmir's readiness for the four Labour Codes. The administration reviewed finalized draft rules for wages, social security, industrial relations, and occupational safety to streamline ease of doing business and worker welfare.

title: Gujarat Labour Department notifies revised VDA for engineering and chemical sector workers
summary: The Gujarat Labour & Employment Department issued an updated Variable Dearness Allowance (VDA) notification for heavy engineering and chemical manufacturing units. The revision mandates a daily wage hike across Zone I and Zone II industrial belts to adjust for semi-annual inflation.

title: Karnataka High Court upholds platform aggregator welfare cess under State Gig Workers Framework
summary: The Karnataka High Court dismissed aggregator petitions challenging state-mandated welfare fee deductions. The court affirmed that state governments hold constitutional competence to institute social security funds and accident insurance safety nets for on-demand app-based delivery and ride-hailing personnel.

title: MoLE guidelines mandate ergonomics standards and heat stress protocols for warehouse and delivery workers
summary: The Ministry of Labour & Employment notified comprehensive occupational safety directives requiring e-commerce hubs and quick-commerce dark stores to provide hydration stations, mandatory rest intervals during peak summer hours, and certified ergonomic gear for ground sorting and delivery staff.

title: State tracker (Aug 2026): Gujarat among frontrunner states with final notified Labour Code rules
summary: A state-by-state labour code compliance audit confirmed Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, and Arunachal Pradesh have published final rules across all four labour codes. Employers in Gujarat are advised to prepare synchronized payroll structures compliant with the unified wage definition.

title: Central Government clarifies cross-border tax and ESIC compliance for permanent remote employees
summary: The Labour Ministry and CBDT issued a joint advisory clarifying that remote employees working from non-headquarter states remain covered under their base establishment's PF registration, while state-level Professional Tax and local Shops & Establishments registrations must align with the employee's physical work location.

title: ESIC expands Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana unemployment relief scheme with simplified claims
summary: ESIC extended the ABVKY relief scheme, granting financial relief of up to 50% of average daily earnings for insured persons rendered unemployed. The new portal allows direct online Aadhaar-linked verification without requiring physical employer attestation in contested termination scenarios.

title: Maharashtra revises minimum wages and special allowances for IT and commercial establishments
summary: Maharashtra Labour Commissionerate published semi-annual VDA hikes applicable to all scheduled employments including commercial establishments and software parks in Mumbai, Pune, and Nagpur zones, establishing updated minimum basic pay baselines for contract technical staff.

title: Government notifies EPF Scheme 2026, replacing 1952 framework; PF interest maintained at 8.25%
summary: The Ministry of Labour formally notified the EPF Scheme 2026, replacing the archaic 1952 framework to align with the Social Security Code. The interest rate remains locked at 8.25% per annum, while modernizing digital claim settlements and auto-transfer procedures.

title: EPFO launches special amnesty campaign for voluntary employer disclosure of un-enrolled workers
summary: EPFO introduced a 120-day voluntary enrolment campaign allowing principal employers and contractors to register left-out contractual and permanent workers without incurring damages or retrospective penal interest under Section 14B of the EPF & MP Act.

title: Rajasthan Gig and Platform Workers Welfare Board commences universal registration on Shramik portal
summary: Rajasthan rolled out mandatory onboarding for aggregator platforms including Zomato, Swiggy, Uber, and Urban Company onto its unified portal. Aggregators must register delivery partners and contribute transaction-based welfare cess into the dedicated social security fund.

title: Parliamentary Committee examines proposal to raise EPS minimum monthly pension to Rs 7,500
summary: The Parliamentary Standing Committee on Labour held deliberations on increasing the minimum monthly pension under EPS-95 from Rs 1,000 to Rs 7,500 with dearness relief. Actuarial cost estimations and central budgetary deficit support were submitted to the Finance Ministry.

title: ESIC enforces 50% basic wage rule across all affiliated industrial units to prevent salary distortion
summary: ESIC issued field inspection guidelines mandating that basic wages and dearness allowance must constitute at least 50% of gross remuneration. Establishments using excessive non-standard allowances to artificially depress ESI wage calculations face retrospective demand notices and scrutiny.

title: Telangana introduces comprehensive social security and accident cover for gig and app delivery personnel
summary: The Telangana Government notified the Gig and Platform Workers Social Security Rules 2026, establishing a Rs 5 lakh accidental insurance benefit, maternity assistance for women delivery executives, and a state dispute resolution ombudsman for platform deactivations.

title: Tamil Nadu notifies updated non-hazardous factory night shift regulations for female personnel
summary: Tamil Nadu notified revised occupational safety guidelines permitting women in electronics and textile manufacturing units to work night shifts subject to mandatory employer-arranged GPS transportation, on-site CCTV surveillance, and specialized 24/7 security arrangements.

title: Centre notifies final Central Rules under all Four Labour Codes in the Official Gazette
summary: The Ministry of Labour & Employment published final central rules under the Code on Wages, Social Security Code, Industrial Relations Code, and OSH Code. The rules establish standard procedures for pan-India single electronic licensing, compounding of offences, and dispute resolution.

title: Gujarat Labour Department releases compliance handbook for the 4 Labour Codes transition
summary: Gujarat's Labour Commissionerate issued a comprehensive transition manual detailing harmonized state rules across the four Labour Codes. The handbook clarifies digital registers, unified annual returns, and self-certification schemes for MSMEs operating in Ahmedabad, Vadodara, and Surat.

title: ESIC clarifies continuity of medical benefits when wages exceed the Rs 21,000 threshold mid-year
summary: ESIC issued an operational circular affirming that if an employee's gross monthly wage crosses the statutory Rs 21,000 ceiling due to an annual appraisal, ESI contributions and full super-speciality medical coverage continue until the end of that statutory contribution period.

title: Gujarat Shops & Establishments Amendment Act enforced with retrospective effect from Dec 2025
summary: The Gujarat Government formally gazetted the Shops & Establishments Amendment Act 2026 with retrospective validity. The amendment grants 24/7 operating freedom for commercial outlets, relaxes overtime limits to 125 hours per quarter, and streamlines single-window digital registration.

title: Gujarat revises minimum wages upward by Rs 12/day across 46 scheduled employments
summary: The Labour & Employment Department of Gujarat revised basic minimum wage rates for the period April to September 2026. The order enforces an increase of approximately Rs 12 per day across Zone I and Zone II classifications for skilled, semi-skilled, and unskilled workforce.

title: Delhi Government issues advisory on ergonomic norms and work-from-home tax compliance for tech firms
summary: Delhi Labour Department released compliance guidance for IT and consulting firms operating hybrid workplace policies. The advisory covers employer-provided home office equipment subsidies, visual display terminal safety breaks, and statutory compliance for distributed remote teams.

title: Industry push mounts to raise ESI wage ceiling from Rs 21,000 to Rs 25,000 per month
summary: Trade unions and employer federations submitted joint memorandums to the Union Labour Minister urging an immediate upward revision in the statutory ESI wage eligibility threshold to Rs 25,000 per month, noting wage inflation since the threshold was last altered in 2017.

title: EPFO higher pension calculation mechanism streamlined for eligible pre-2014 contributing members
summary: EPFO published revised mathematical calculation parameters for eligible private-sector members who opted for pension on higher actual wages pursuant to Supreme Court orders. The circular outlines transfer mechanics between EPF and EPS funds for retiring employees.

title: Ministry of Labour sets Rs 18,000 wage ceiling for supervisory classification under labour dispute laws
summary: The Ministry of Labour and Employment published a statutory notification raising the supervisory wage ceiling threshold to Rs 18,000 per month under industrial dispute rules, clarifying which employees are legally classified as managerial staff versus protected workmen.

title: Gujarat Gazette notifies Social Security Rules: 1-year gratuity eligibility for fixed-term contracts
summary: Gujarat's Official Gazette notified amendment rules under the Social Security framework, reducing continuous service requirements for gratuity from 5 years to 1 year for fixed-term contract staff. The rules also mandate a Rs 15,000 fatal accident funeral deposit.

title: Union Budget 2026-27 allocates Rs 32,666 crore to Labour Ministry with focused skilling incentives
summary: Union Budget 2026-27 earmarked Rs 32,666 crore for the Labour Ministry, featuring expanded Employment Linked Incentive (ELI) schemes reimbursing EPFO contributions for first-time formal sector employees across manufacturing and tech hubs for a two-year duration.

title: Gujarat raises Shops & Establishments coverage threshold to 20 employees, slashing compliance burden
summary: Gujarat revised applicability parameters under its Shops and Establishments Act, raising the employee threshold triggering mandatory registration and statutory register maintenance from 10 to 20 employees, substantially reducing compliance overhead for micro-enterprises and retail outlets.

title: Implementation status review: 30 States finalize draft rules for the Consolidated Labour Codes
summary: A nationwide compliance review published in January 2026 indicated that 30 states and union territories have pre-published draft rules across all four Labour Codes. Regional compliance workshops were mandated to ensure tripartite alignment with industrial employer federations.

title: MoLE introduces e-Shram 2.0 with integrated social security linkages for unorganized & contract workers
summary: The Union Labour Ministry inaugurated e-Shram 2.0, connecting the unorganized worker registry directly with Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana and Ayushman Bharat databases, enabling automated benefit disbursals for migrant, platform, and construction laborers across India.

title: Commerce Ministry updates SEZ Work-From-Home rules, permitting 100% hybrid flexibility for tech units
summary: The Ministry of Commerce and Industry issued revised Special Economic Zone (SEZ) Rule 43A guidelines, allowing IT/ITES units in SEZs to permit 100% remote working without standard time-bound operational limits, subject to electronic asset tracking and duty-free laptop records.

title: Gujarat Industrial Relations Tribunal mandates uniform gratuity computation on actual basic wages
summary: The Gujarat Industrial Relations Tribunal ruled in a major textile case that special allowances inseparably linked to basic performance must be included in gratuity wage calculations, preventing employers from calculating final terminal settlements on arbitrarily split basic pay components.

title: Centre notifies national framework for Gig & Platform Worker Social Security Fund under Code on SS
summary: The Central Government gazetted the administrative blueprint for the National Social Security Board for Gig Workers. Aggregators in ride-hailing, food delivery, and logistics must contribute 1-2% of annual turnover capped at 5% of total gig payouts towards the fund.

title: EPFO activates automated claim settlement for illness, education and housing withdrawals up to Rs 1 Lakh
summary: EPFO expanded its auto-mode claim settlement facility for advance PF withdrawals up to Rs 1,00,000 for medical emergencies, marriage, and housing. The IT system processes and credits legitimate claims within 72 hours using automated KYC and bank validation algorithms.

title: Uttar Pradesh approves comprehensive draft rules under Occupational Safety, Health & Working Conditions Code
summary: The Uttar Pradesh Cabinet approved final state rules under the OSH Code 2020. The rules introduce standardized annual health check-ups at employer cost for factory workers over 45 years, canteen facilities for units with 100+ workers, and mandatory crèche provisions.

title: Supreme Court clarifies PF deduction obligations on non-production special allowances for private firms
summary: A three-judge bench of the Supreme Court reiterated that allowances paid uniformly and universally to all employees across the board must be treated as basic wages for mandatory provident fund contributions, upholding the precedent established in the historic Vivekananda Vidyamandir judgment.

title: Gujarat Labour Welfare Board launches revised financial assistance schemes for factory staff families
summary: The Gujarat Labour Welfare Board enhanced educational scholarships, higher education grants, and accidental death compensation for registered industrial workers. Employers must ensure semi-annual employee-employer contribution remittances are completed via the GLWB web portal.

title: Rajasthan passes landmark Platform Based Gig Workers Welfare Act with dedicated social security board
summary: Rajasthan notified operational rules under its pioneering Platform Based Gig Workers Act. The framework mandates unique worker identification IDs, creates a tripartite welfare board, and imposes automated welfare fee deductions on every app-based customer transaction across food and ride-hailing services.

title: ESIC enhances maternity benefit claims processing through instant online Aadhaar-linked verification
summary: ESIC digitized the 26-week paid maternity benefit settlement mechanism, allowing insured female employees to upload Form-19 and medical fitness certificates online. Direct benefit transfers (DBT) are released to validated bank accounts within 10 days of claim submission.
